{{Top|leg}}
A '''Visitor's Tax''' was payable for any individual wishing to set foot on [[Algara II]]. It cost twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], upon receipt of which an [[Algarian Visitor Identification chip]] was issued.
